newsitem.title: UK: M.A.I.D. adds to Newsline data base.
newsitem.headline: M.A.I.D. adds to Newsline data base.

text.p: Electronic information provider M.A.I.D. plc said on Tuesday it was adding the Times, the Sunday Times and BBC Worldwide Monitoring Service to its Newsline database.
The company also lashed out at a Financial Times article on Monday which said it was "struggling to fill gaps" after Reuters denied it access to its news database.

"M.A.I.D has for some time been pursuing a strategy to form links with news sources directly in order to improve the speed of availability and to ensure that indexing is accurately applied to their titles," it said.
The company said that by dealing directly with sources, it has "been able to improve margins by retaining royalties that would otherwise have been paid to aggregators".
M.A.I.D. shares fell on Monday on the FT story which said Reuters had stopped updating news stories on business databases operated by M.A.I.D. and its larger rival Reed Elsevier.
